messages:
Sam Walker: Heads up — planning the next Architecture Review Board (ARB) cadence and facilitator rotation. Thinking monthly meeting + rotating facilitator. Want to finalize before next week so we can publish the invite and agenda doc.

Alex Chen: +1 to rotation. I can take the May slot if that helps. :raised_hand:

Priya Nair: Thanks — what's the proposed day/time? My afternoons are rough because of customer calls.

Sam Walker: Proposed: 2nd Thursday, 10:00am PT (60m). Keeps it out of core sprint planning windows. Open to alternatives.

Miguel Torres: Quick thought — are we sure monthly is enough? Some of the infra RFCs are landing faster. Maybe monthly + 2-week ad-hoc triage (30m) for urgent platform rollouts?

Dana Li: Monthly + ad-hoc triage sounds good. For the ad-hoc, can we limit to 3 agenda slots and require a short preread? Means it stays focused.

Alex Chen: Agreed on prereads. Also proposing a very lightweight facilitator checklist. Example:
```
- Confirm prereads posted 48h prior
- Assign 2 reviewers for each RFC
- Timebox each review to 15m
- Note action owners & follow-ups in the doc
```

Priya Nair: Perfect. I can help maintain the rotation sheet if someone creates it.

Sam Walker: I made a starter agenda + rotation sheet in the doc: https://redwood/doc/arb/agenda-rotation (please add permission if you need access). Add your name to the sign-up column and indicate any blocks.

Alex Chen: Added myself for May. Also dropped in the "facilitator notes" template.

Priya Nair: Can we add "Model-serving guidelines RFC" for the May agenda? I want 20 minutes for architecture review + 10 for rollout constraints.

Sam Walker: Yes — add the RFC link to the agenda doc under May items and tag @alex for reviewer. We'll timebox like you suggested.

Miguel Torres: For the ad-hoc triage: recommend first-come rule but facilitator can reprioritize if it's an outage/priority.

Dana Li: One operational ask: calendar invites should include a link to the prereads section and the note-taking doc. Less hunting.

Sam Walker: Good call — will update invite template. Plan: publish recurring invite (2nd Thu 10am PT monthly), add ad-hoc 30m slot (calendar placeholder), and share rotation sheet by EOD. If anyone can't attend, put your proxy in the sheet.

Priya Nair: Sounds good. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: Thanks — ping me if you want me to shepherd the Model-serving RFC preread.

Sam Walker: Will do. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the invite + updated doc link.

calendabot: Event created: ARB — Recurring monthly, 2nd Thu 10:00am PT. Invite includes link to agenda doc.
